title: Phase 3: vsdd subprocess client + drift handling + templates deployment
description:
v0.1.0 blocker.

Scope: (1) Add src/mdatron.rs to vsdd: subprocess invocation wrapper for mdatron verify --json + envelope parsing + exit-code mapping. (2) Remove mdatron-core = { path = ... } from vsdd-core/Cargo.toml. (3) Migrate vsdd-core/tests/init.rs + tests/cross_references.rs: integration tests now spawn mdatron binary against fixture projects rather than calling library APIs. (4) Migrate vsdd init from two-way (manifest vs current) to three-way (manifest vs current vs new_template) classification per crosslink/src/commands/init/manifest.rs:classify_update. (5) Add --force / --update / --no-prompt / --dry-run to vsdd's init CLI. (6) Extend ManifestEntry with template_version_at_deploy field (breaking manifest change - land before v0.1.0 publishes). (7) Implement interactive prompt on Conflict action per crosslink. (8) vsdd init template deployment: extend artifact registry to include templates/* files (DESIGN.md.vsdd-template + 3 registry yamls + 2 github workflows).

Acceptance: vsdd's tests pass without depending on mdatron-core library API; vsdd init re-run after a toolkit version bump exercises Conflict path; --no-prompt skips, --force overwrites, --dry-run previews; templates deploy alongside 42 markdown artifacts.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 3. Blocked by Phase 2.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: RECONCILE (2026-07-29 audit vs the repo, correcting an earlier over-optimistic read): #14 is ~1.5 of 8 items done — a REAL blocker on #15, not stale-but-done. DONE: (2) mdatron-core path dep removed (no mdatron-core anywhere); (3, partial) cross_references.rs spawns the mdatron binary. NOT DONE: (1) src/mdatron.rs subprocess client — absent; no runtime Command::new('mdatron') in vsdd/vsdd-core src (only in the cross_references TEST); (3, partial) init.rs test migration status unclear; (4) three-way init classification — absent; (5) --force/--update/--no-prompt/--dry-run flags — absent; (6) ManifestEntry.template_version_at_deploy — absent; (7) interactive Conflict prompt — not evidenced; (8) vsdd init template deployment (templates/* in the artifact registry) — not evidenced. So #15 (vsdd-core removal / Slice-1 merge) stays genuinely blocked until #14's Phase-3 work lands. My earlier 'much may be done' was an assumption, not verified — flagging per the verify-built-state discipline.
